note: Paragraph 1: ToUnicode maps every ASCII letter to the next letter (a->b): the page shows correct text but the CMap lies. Paragraph 2: ToUnicode omits all vowels.
signal: Expected = what the page shows; a tool can only get it by distrusting the CMap and using the embedded font cmap. Most will output shifted text (para 1) and either drop the vowels, emit U+FFFD, or fill them from the font (para 2).
